change.item: Package: DOCman Pro 1.11.0: Category, File extension and File size fixed; new Link, Download Link, Image, dates, Author, Downloads and readable File Size fields; category list with child categories and ordering.
DOCman Pro 1.11.0: DOCman API errors are written to the Joomla log (category "elemen") instead of being silently ignored.

fix.item: DOCman Pro 1.11.0: Category, File extension and File size were always empty.

addition.item: DOCman Pro 1.11.0: Link and Download Link fields, through the document's DOCman menu item (as DOCman's own documents module; without a DOCman menu item there is no link).
DOCman Pro 1.11.0: Image (DOCman thumbnail, resizable by YOOtheme), Icon Name, Created and Modified dates, Author, Downloads, File Type, MIME Type and a readable File Size such as "4.8 MB".
DOCman Pro 1.11.0: Dates use YOOtheme's date format options; Title and Description can be shortened.
DOCman Pro 1.11.0: Documents list: choose categories from a list (several at once), include child categories, and order by newest, oldest, title, downloads, last modified or DOCman ordering.

change.item: Package: Header Pro 2.0.0: Smart Search removed; Scroll Progress gets colours (theme, gradient or custom), height, a position below the header and a soft glow; five new menu styles (Soft Pill, Outline, Segmented, Overline, Dot), line animations and gradient lines; an Announcement Bar; shadow only after scrolling; a gradient border.

remove.item: Header Pro 2.0.0: The Smart Search control from 1.2.0 and its settings (Search, Search Position, search in the mobile header). Saved values are ignored; use YOOtheme's own search module instead.

addition.item: Header Pro 2.0.0: Scroll Progress: Progress Colour (Primary, Secondary, a primary-to-secondary gradient or your own one or two colours), Progress Height (1 to 8 px), Progress Position (top of the window or right below the header, following the sticky navbar) and a soft glow. A gradient spans the window and the bar uncovers it as visitors scroll.

Header Pro 2.0.0: Menu Style: Soft Pill (a light wash of the primary colour), Outline (a thin ring), Segmented (the items in a tray, the active one a raised tab), Overline and Dot, next to Pill and Underline. All of them work with the sliding highlight and on dark tints.
Header Pro 2.0.0: Underline and Overline: Line Animation (grow from the middle, grow from the start or fade in) and an optional primary-to-secondary gradient line.

Header Pro 2.0.0: Announcement Bar: a bar above the header with a text, an optional link (or link text with an arrow), in the theme's primary, secondary, muted or default colours or a gradient, on all pages or the home page only. Visitors can close it; a new text shows again. Texts and link can be translated per language.
Header Pro 2.0.0: Effects: Shadow only after scrolling, and a Gradient border (a 2px primary-to-secondary line under a full-width bar, a gradient ring around a capsule).
Package: Header Pro 1.2.0: optional Smart Search in the desktop or mobile header, styled by the active theme.
Package: DOCman Pro 1.10.0: use published DOCman documents as YOOtheme dynamic content sources.
DOCman Pro 1.10.0: Initial DOCman dynamic content source for one document and document lists.
DOCman Pro 1.10.0: Published documents are fetched through the DOCman PHP API with the current user's permissions.
Header Pro 1.2.0: Optional Smart Search control in the header or navbar, with keyboard-accessible disclosure, theme-aware colours and responsive mobile placement.

change.item: Package: Pricing Pro 1.5.0 and Marquee Pro 1.1.0 use theme-aware controls and surfaces for light and dark sections.
Animated Background Pro 2.0.0: Existing 1.x background settings continue to use the legacy rendering path; Scene Editor 2.0 stays opt-in.
Marquee Pro 1.1.0: Card-style marquee items use a light or inverse translucent surface to stay distinct in light and dark sections.
Pricing Pro 1.5.0: The Monthly / Yearly switch uses an inverse translucent active state in dark sections while keeping its light-surface appearance in light sections.

addition.item: Animated Background Pro 2.0.0: Optional Scene Editor with up to three visual layers, editable presets, per-layer palettes, intensity, speed, position and direction, plus Auto/Light/Dark appearance and mobile behaviour.

fix.item: Animated Background Pro 2.0.0: Tech Grid now uses the theme palette by default, and pattern contrast is boosted on Primary/Secondary sections so the grid remains visible.

addition.item: Package: Animated Background Pro 1.1.0: six ready-made presets for aurora, gradient, grids, dots, waves and shapes.
Animated Background Pro 1.1.0: Ready-made Calm Aurora, Soft Gradient, Tech Grid, Quiet Dots, Ocean Waves and Playful Shapes presets; Custom keeps the existing controls.
Package: Heading Pro 1.2.0: Raised (Emboss) and Inset (Deboss) Background Text with strength settings, plus Soft Shadow and Gradient Fade effects.
Heading Pro 1.2.0: Raised (Emboss) and Inset (Deboss) depth effects for Background Text, with Soft, Medium and Strong strength settings.
Heading Pro 1.2.0: Soft Shadow and Gradient Fade styles for Background Text.
Package: Heading Pro 1.1.0: line-by-line reveal, independently styled braced phrases and reveal presets.
Heading Pro 1.1.0: Line-by-line text reveal, with delays recalculated when the heading wraps at a new width.
Heading Pro 1.1.0: Braced phrases can choose a theme colour and effect independently, e.g. {websites|primary|marker}.
Heading Pro 1.1.0: Subtle, Editorial and Bold reveal presets; Custom keeps the individual animation controls.
Pricing Pro 1.4.0: First release: pricing plans side by side, each with a name, description, badge, icon or image, monthly and yearly price, a note under the price, a list of features and a button.

Pricing Pro 1.4.0: A Monthly / Yearly switch with a savings badge (e.g. "Save 20%"). Prices are formatted with the currency before or after, decimals and separators; text such as "Free" shows as written.
Pricing Pro 1.4.0: Feature lines starting with "x " show as not included.
Pricing Pro 1.4.0: One plan can be highlighted: larger, with a border, or as a primary card, and shown first on phones.
Pricing Pro 1.4.0: Plans can come from dynamic content such as articles; texts can be translated with a multilingual plugin that reads the "translate" flag.
Table Pro 1.3.0: Search: a search box over every cell, with the matches highlighted. Accents can be ignored, so "cafe" finds "café".
Table Pro 1.3.0: Sorting: visitors sort by the columns you allow, by value: numbers and ratings as numbers, dates as dates, yes / no and text in order. The table can start sorted by a column.
Table Pro 1.3.0: Filters: a dropdown with the values of a column; values separated by commas (such as tags) can be separate choices.
Table Pro 1.3.0: Pages: show a number of rows per page, with page links and "Showing 1–10 of 42".
Table Pro 1.3.0: Everything works in the browser without loading data; without JavaScript every row shows.

Table Pro 1.2.0: First release: tables with up to 24 columns. Each column has a heading, a type (text, number, date, image, icon, rating, yes / no, button or tags), alignment, width and the screen size from which it shows. Text can be shortened to a number of characters; numbers get decimals, separators and text before or after (e.g. RM); dates take one of 17 formats in the site language.
Table Pro 1.2.0: Every cell can have its own link. Images open in a lightbox, row numbers can be added, and the header row can stay in view while the table scrolls in a box.
Table Pro 1.2.0: On small screens the table scrolls sideways or shows each row as a card with the column names.
Table Pro 1.2.0: Rows can come from dynamic content such as articles. Headings and cells can be translated with a multilingual plugin that reads the "translate" flag.
Header Pro 1.1.0: The header button text and link can be translated per language with a multilingual plugin that reads the customizer's "translate" flag, such as TerjemahYOOPro.

fix.item: Header Pro 1.0.2: Capsule with the navbar Dropdown set to *Dropbar*: opening a dropdown showed a full-width white bar that covered the page and the lower edge of the capsule. The bar is now left out, and each dropdown shows as a card just below the capsule, in the theme's dropdown colour (glass with Dropdowns: Glass).

Header Pro 1.0.1: Sticky Height: an SVG logo without its own width and height (only a viewBox) disappeared while the navbar was sticky. The logo now gets a height, never more than its own, so it shrinks instead.

change.item: Animated Background Pro 1.0.0: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.
Countdown Pro 1.0.0: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.

Countdown Pro 1.0.0: Settings renamed for clarity: labels is now label_language, pad is pad_numbers, color is number_color, color_custom is number_color_custom and separator is show_separator. Older layouts are migrated automatically when they load, dynamic content mappings included.

Countdown Pro 1.0.0: Label Language offers Page language (the default) or English. The Malay option is gone: labels come from the language files in the page's language, so a Malay page shows Malay labels. Layouts that chose Malay switch to Page language automatically.
Counter Pro 1.0.0: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.

Counter Pro 1.0.0: Number Format "Malay (1.3 juta)" is now "Words (1.3 million)": the words come from the plugin's language files in the page's language (English and Malay included, other languages through Language Overrides). Layouts that chose Malay switch to Words automatically, so Malay pages still show "1.3 juta".
Counter Pro 1.0.0: The item's Color setting is now Number Color (color renamed to number_color). Older layouts are migrated automatically when they load.
Flip Box Pro 1.0.0: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.

Flip Box Pro 1.0.0: Clearer setting names: Front/Back Text Color (front_text_color, back_text_color, on the element and on items), Back List Icon and Back List Icon Color (back_list_icon, back_list_icon_color, back_list_icon_lucide). Older layouts are migrated automatically when they load, dynamic content mappings included.

Flip Box Pro 1.0.0: Keyboard and screen readers: the box itself is no longer a focusable "button" around links. Each box has a real toggle button (read out, not shown; "Show the back" with the front title) for both triggers, and a click anywhere on a Click box still turns it. The side that is turned away is inert, so its links can't be reached with Tab.
Flip Box Pro 1.0.0: The Hover trigger option is called Hover; keyboard users use the toggle button.
Grid Pro 1.0.0: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.

Grid Pro 1.0.0: Clearer setting names: the item's Bento Size is bento_size (was size) and Toolbar Alignment is toolbar_align (was filter_align). Older layouts are migrated automatically when they load, dynamic content mappings included.
Grid Pro 1.0.0: The Load More label can only be set when Items Shown First is set, and Toolbar Alignment only with the filter or search on.
Grid Pro 1.0.0: The filter buttons group is named for screen readers ("Filter by tag", from the language files).
Header Pro 1.0.0: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.

Header Pro 1.0.0: Clearer setting names before 1.0: show_when, capsule_width, capsule_gap, capsule_radius, sticky_height, menu_style, dropdown_style, dialog_style and mobile_apply. Settings saved under the older names are taken over automatically and saved under the new names next time.
Header Pro 1.0.0: The divider and the mobile header option have their own labels (**Divider**, **Mobile Header**), and Glass Opacity and Glass Blur each say what they set.
Heading Pro 1.0.0: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.
Icon Pro 1.0.0: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.

Icon Pro 1.0.0: Grid columns work like YOOtheme's own elements: Phone Portrait, Phone Landscape, Tablet Landscape and Desktop, each with Inherit (the next smaller size) and "Fill the row equally". They replace Columns and Columns on Phones.

Icon Pro 1.0.0: Settings renamed for consistency: Shape Size, On Hover and Keep Moving are now stored as shape_size, animate_hover and animate_loop. Older layouts are migrated automatically, with their column, shape and animation choices kept.
Icon Pro 1.0.0: The icon field Icon Pro adds to other Elemen elements and to YOOtheme menu items is now called "Icon (Icon Pro)": it takes Lucide names, uikit: names and class: icon fonts.
Icon Pro 1.0.0: The icon gallery's built-in search words are English. Malay search words moved to a separate file and are loaded when the Joomla administrator language is Malay.
Marquee Pro 1.0.0: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.
Marquee Pro 1.0.0: The pause button is on by default for new marquees and for older layouts that never changed the setting (WCAG 2.2.2: moving content can be paused).
Marquee Pro 1.0.0: The pause button keeps one name, "Pause animation" (from the language files), and tells screen readers whether it is pressed, instead of switching between Pause and Play.
Progress Bar Pro 1.0.0: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.
Shape Dividers Pro 1.0.0: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.
Shape Dividers Pro 1.0.0: The plugin description mentions columns, which have dividers since 0.8.0.
Tabs Pro 1.0.0: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.
Tabs Pro 1.0.0: The step numbers option is called show_numbers (was numbers). Older layouts are migrated automatically when they load.
Timeline Pro 1.0.0: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.

Timeline Pro 1.0.0: Clearer setting names: Fill the line is line_fill (was progress) and its color line_fill_color (was progress_color). Older layouts are migrated automatically when they load, dynamic content mappings included.
Timeline Pro 1.0.0: Line fill, group label and sticky group options are disabled for the Horizontal layout, which doesn't use them.
Timeline Pro 1.0.0: The horizontal scroller is a named region for screen readers, and the Previous/Next button labels come from the language files (English and Malay).

fix.item: Countdown Pro 1.0.0: Every day mode stays on the chosen time across daylight saving time changes in the site's time zone (it used to add a fixed 24 hours).
Countdown Pro 1.0.0: The script only watches the page for replaced elements inside the builder preview, not on every page view.
Countdown Pro 1.0.0: Number Color only accepts its own options.
Counter Pro 1.0.0: The title's HTML element only accepts h1 to h6 or div; anything else falls back to div.
Counter Pro 1.0.0: The script only watches the page for replaced elements inside the builder preview, not on every page view.
Flip Box Pro 1.0.0: Title HTML Element only accepts h1-h6 and div (h1 and h6 added to the list).
Flip Box Pro 1.0.0: The link of the plain HTML copy stored for search is escaped.
Grid Pro 1.0.0: Title HTML Element only accepts h1-h6 and div (h1, h5 and h6 added to the list).
Grid Pro 1.0.0: The link of the plain HTML copy stored for search is escaped.
Heading Pro 1.0.0: Rotating words stay on the first word for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
Heading Pro 1.0.0: Rotating words share one window resize listener, so editing in the builder no longer adds a new one each time the preview refreshes.
Heading Pro 1.0.0: The link in the plain HTML used for search is escaped.
Icon Pro 1.0.0: A ; or : in a tooltip no longer cuts the tooltip short.
Icon Pro 1.0.0: Links that open in a new window get rel="noopener".
Icon Pro 1.0.0: The screen reader name "Icon" for linked icon fonts and images comes from the language files.
Marquee Pro 1.0.0: A linked item without text or an image alt text is named after its icon, or else the address it links to, for screen readers.
Marquee Pro 1.0.0: The pause button's label is escaped.
Progress Bar Pro 1.0.0: The goal text for screen readers ("Goal") comes from the plugin's language files, in the page's language.
Progress Bar Pro 1.0.0: A Maximum of zero or below counts as 100 instead of breaking the bar.
Progress Bar Pro 1.0.0: The plain text copy (search, builder off) no longer shows a stray ": " when an item has no value, e.g. an empty dynamic field.
Progress Bar Pro 1.0.0: The script only watches the page for replaced elements inside the builder preview, not on every page view.
Tabs Pro 1.0.0: Accordion Title HTML Element only accepts h2-h6 and div (h6 added to the list).
Tabs Pro 1.0.0: The link of the plain HTML copy stored for search is escaped.
Tabs Pro 1.0.0: No script error in browsers without the Web Animations getAnimations() method.
Timeline Pro 1.0.0: Numbered markers and alternating sides count only the items that are shown: an empty item in between no longer skips a number or a side.
Timeline Pro 1.0.0: Title HTML Element only accepts h1-h6 and div (h1 and h6 added to the list).
Timeline Pro 1.0.0: The link of the plain HTML copy stored for search is escaped.

note.item: Progress Bar Pro 1.0.0: No settings were renamed, so older layouts load unchanged.

addition.item: Header Pro 0.21.0: **Capsule Width: Fit content**: the capsule only as wide as the logo, menu and modules, floating in the middle.
Header Pro 0.21.0: **Slide the highlight**: with Pill or Underline, one highlight slides to the menu item under the pointer or keyboard focus and back to the active item.
Header Pro 0.21.0: **Start After**: the glass or solid surface only once the page is scrolled this far, for example past a hero image.
Header Pro 0.21.0: **Slide in when it appears**: the capsule drops in softly (the full-width bar fades in).
Header Pro 0.21.0: **Mobile Shape**: the mobile header can be a full-width bar under a desktop capsule, or the other way round.

fix.item: Header Pro 0.21.0: Menu items on a dark tint (light text) were UIkit's half-strength white and hard to read on a coloured glass; now a stronger white.

addition.item: Header Pro 0.20.0: **Menu Dialog: Cards**: the mobile menu (and the menu dialog, if used) with rounded menu items, the active one in the theme's primary colour, and a round close button above the menu.
Header Pro 0.20.0: **Scroll Progress**: a thin bar in the primary colour at the top of the window that fills as visitors scroll, on all pages or on articles only.

Header Pro 0.20.0: **Button** at the end of the header or navbar, with its own link, style (primary, secondary, default), new window option, and optionally in the mobile header. Its text can be a language string, so it can be translated with language overrides.

fix.item: Header Pro 0.20.0: With *Blend with page content* (transparent header), the glass or solid surface is left out: the blend inverted its colours. Menu style, dropdowns and the button stay.

addition.item: Header Pro 0.19.0: Show the glass or solid navbar **Always**, not only while sticky: a floating capsule from the top of the page, with space and a shadow below it. Works without a sticky navbar.

Header Pro 0.19.0: **Menu Style**: Pill (rounded item, the active one in the theme's primary colour, or white on dark tints) or Underline (a line growing from the middle on hover). Items keep their height, so dropdowns stay where they are.
Header Pro 0.19.0: **Dropdowns: Glass**: rounded, see-through dropdowns with a soft shadow and rounded items.
Header Pro 0.19.0: A divider between the menu and the modules after it, such as a language switcher.
Header Pro 0.19.0: Menu style, dropdowns and divider also work without a glass or solid navbar.

change.item: Header Pro 0.19.0: Field labels: Header Pro Style, Show, Shape, Tint, Effects.

addition.item: Header Pro 0.18.0: Sticky Style in the customizer under Header: while the navbar is sticky it becomes frosted glass or a solid bar, full width or a floating capsule.
Header Pro 0.18.0: Tint from the theme: its background, muted, primary or secondary colour, so it follows the style chosen in the customizer. Menu text turns light on dark tints.

Header Pro 0.18.0: Opacity, blur, capsule gap and corners, shadow, border, and a smaller navbar height while sticky. Applies to the mobile header too, unless switched off; a static mobile navbar then becomes sticky like the desktop one.
Header Pro 0.18.0: Falls back to a nearly solid bar in browsers without backdrop blur, and skips the transitions when visitors prefer reduced motion.
Counter Pro 0.17.0: Display options in the Content tab, as in YOOtheme's own elements: show or hide the title, meta text, content, image, icon and link of all items without deleting them.

Flip Box Pro 0.17.0: Display options in the Content tab, as in YOOtheme's own elements: show or hide the front title, front content, image, icon, back title, back content, back list and link of all items without deleting them.
Grid Pro 0.17.0: Display options in the Content tab, as in YOOtheme's own elements: show or hide the title, meta text, content, image and link of all items without deleting them.
Icon Pro 0.17.0: Display options in the Content tab, as in YOOtheme's own elements: show or hide the label, tooltip and link of all items without deleting them.
Progress Bar Pro 0.17.0: Display options in the Content tab, as in YOOtheme's own elements: show or hide the title, content and goal of all items without deleting them.
Tabs Pro 0.17.0: Display options in the Content tab, as in YOOtheme's own elements: show or hide the badge, icon, image and link of all items without deleting them.
Timeline Pro 0.17.0: Display options in the Content tab, as in YOOtheme's own elements: show or hide the title, meta text, content, image and link of all items without deleting them.

Marquee Pro 0.16.0: Display options in the Content tab, as in YOOtheme's own elements: show or hide the text, images, icons and links of all items without deleting them, e.g. logos only. Linked items without their text keep it as a name for screen readers.

fix.item: Animated Background Pro 0.15.1: Shape Dividers in a section with an animated background dropped into the content as white bands instead of sitting on the section's edges. Content that is positioned on purpose now keeps its position, and dividers always show above the animation.

change.item: Package: Sites with the package see one "Elemen" row in Joomla's update list, also when single elements have new versions. The package gets its updates from package.xml; the elements inside it no longer register an update server of their own, and the shared update server of earlier versions is removed when the package is installed. Single element zips still update on their own.

addition.item: Animated Background Pro 0.15.0: First release: an Animated Background panel for YOOtheme's Section, opened from its Settings tab, with five effects behind the content: Aurora (soft lights drifting slowly), Gradient Flow (colour bands flowing across the section), Waves (three layered waves along the bottom), Moving Pattern (a fine grid, dots or diagonal lines drifting slowly, fading out towards the edges, in any size) and Floating Shapes (circles, rounded squares, rings or triangles rising slowly; 8, 14 or 22 of them).
Animated Background Pro 0.15.0: Grain: a fine, still grain texture over the section background, with any effect or on its own.

Animated Background Pro 0.15.0: Colours: Auto (the theme's primary colour, and light glows on Primary and Secondary sections, held back so the section keeps its colour and its text stays readable), Corporate, Vibrant, or three custom colours.
Animated Background Pro 0.15.0: Intensity (subtle, medium, strong) and speed (slow, medium, fast, still). The defaults are subtle and slow, so the effect suits business sites as it is.

Animated Background Pro 0.15.0: Light on the browser: only transform and opacity are animated, animations pause while the section is off screen, and visitors who prefer reduced motion see a still picture.

fix.item: Marquee Pro 0.14.1: Links work on every item on screen. The copies that fill the row were not clickable, so with few items most of the links on screen did nothing. Copies stay hidden from screen readers and are skipped by the Tab key.
Marquee Pro 0.14.1: Linked items fade slightly on hover and show a focus ring for keyboard users.

addition.item: Icon Pro 0.14.0: Icon fonts such as Flaticon UIcons, Font Awesome or Bootstrap Icons: add their stylesheet URLs in the plugin options (System → Plugins → Icon Pro), then write class: and the icon's classes in any icon field, e.g. class:fi fi-rr-home. The stylesheets load only on pages that show such an icon. Works in Icon Pro, in the Lucide Icon fields of the other elements and in YOOtheme menus. Colours (gradients fill the glyph), sizes, shapes, hover and looping animations apply; drawing, line weight and duotone are for Lucide icons.

Icon Pro 0.13.0: Lucide icons in YOOtheme menus: menu items get a Lucide Icon field after their Icon field (with the icon picker), and the icon shows in every menu type (navbar, dropdown, offcanvas, icon nav, subnav) with the same size and spacing as YOOtheme's own icons.

change.item: Countdown Pro 0.12.2: Day, hour, minute and second labels come from the plugin's language files (English and Malay), so other languages can be added with Joomla's Language Overrides.

Grid Pro 0.12.2: Labels shown to visitors (All, Search, Load more, no results) come from the plugin's language files (English and Malay), so other languages can be added with Joomla's Language Overrides. The element's own label fields still take priority.
Icon Pro 0.12.2: The icon gallery and the builder's icon picker are in English only. Malay search words (rumah, kedai, telefon, …) still find icons.
Marquee Pro 0.12.2: The pause button's Pause and Play labels come from the plugin's language files.

fix.item: Icon Pro 0.12.1: Icon picker in the builder: the gallery says that a click chooses the icon, the search box has the focus when it opens, and the close button no longer sits on the scroll bar.

addition.item: Heading Pro 0.12.0: Lucide Icon field, with Icon Pro installed: a Lucide icon instead of the UIkit icon.

Icon Pro 0.12.0: Icon picker in the builder: the "Open the icon gallery" link under an icon field opens the gallery in a dialog over the builder, and clicking an icon fills the field. Escape or a click outside closes it.
Icon Pro 0.12.0: Lucide Icon fields for Heading Pro and Marquee Pro (item icon and separator icon).
Marquee Pro 0.12.0: Lucide Icon fields, with Icon Pro installed: Lucide icons for the items and the separator.
Counter Pro 0.11.0: Lucide Icon field, with Icon Pro installed: a Lucide icon instead of the UIkit icon.
Flip Box Pro 0.11.0: Lucide Icon fields, with Icon Pro installed: Lucide icons instead of the UIkit icons for the item and for the back list.

Icon Pro 0.11.0: Other Elemen elements can use Lucide icons: Icon Pro adds a Lucide Icon field after the icon fields of Counter Pro, Flip Box Pro (item icon and back list icon), Timeline Pro (marker icons) and Tabs Pro.

Icon Pro 0.11.0: Icon gallery: the picked icon stays in a bar at the bottom, to copy its name, copy it as SVG or download an .svg file, in a chosen color and line weight, for YOOtheme's own elements (image fields, HTML element).
Tabs Pro 0.11.0: Lucide Icon field, with Icon Pro installed: a Lucide icon in the title instead of the UIkit icon.
Timeline Pro 0.11.0: Lucide Icon fields, with Icon Pro installed: Lucide icons as markers, for the default marker icon and for each item.

Icon Pro 0.10.0: First release: Lucide 1.70.0 icons (2,029, plus 293 older names), UIkit icons and your own images, in a row or grid with labels, links, tooltips and their own colors. Shapes (circle, square, rounded, blob) that are filled, soft, outline or gradient, line weight, gradient and soft-fill icons. Icons that draw themselves, fade, zoom or rise into view, hover effects (spin, bounce, pulse, shake, lift, fill) and looping pulse, float, wiggle or morph. Only the icons used are in the page, as inline SVG. A searchable gallery with Malay and English words copies an icon's name.

Countdown Pro 0.9.0: First release: count down to a date and time in the site's time zone, to a time every day, or an evergreen countdown that starts on each visitor's first visit (and can start again). Plain, boxes, progress circles or flip cards, a choice of units, labels in Malay or English, and when time is up hide the countdown, show a message or go to a page.

Grid Pro 0.9.0: First release: grid, masonry or bento layouts (wide, tall and large items), columns per screen size and a swipe carousel on phones. A tag filter with animated reordering, a search box and a Load more button. Cards with the text below or over the image, and zoom, lift or tilt on hover. Items can come from dynamic content, e.g. one per article with its tags as filters.

Marquee Pro 0.9.0: First release: text, icons or logos scrolling without end, to the left or right or in two rows going opposite ways. Speed in pixels per second, pause or slow down on hover, faded edges, separators, outline text, grey logos that turn to color on hover, and a tilted ribbon with a background. Visitors who prefer less motion get a row they can scroll themselves.

Tabs Pro 0.9.0: First release: tabs or an accordion in one element. Tabs turn into an accordion below 640px or 960px. Underline, pill and segmented tab styles with a sliding indicator, tabs across the top or down the side, icons, step numbers and badges in the titles. A link to #name opens that tab, and the browser's find in page opens the tab holding the match.

Shape Dividers Pro 0.8.0: Shape dividers for columns: the same Shape Divider panel in the Column settings, with a top and a bottom shape inside the column's tile, card, background color, image or video box. Color Auto takes the background of the section around the column, so the shape looks cut out of it. Rounded card corners are kept; the default height is 60px.

change.item: Shape Dividers Pro 0.7.1: Renamed to Shape Dividers Pro, to match the other elements. The plugin is now plg_system_elemen_shapes_pro; installing it disables the old plg_system_elemen_shapes, which can then be uninstalled. Section settings and saved layouts stay as they are.

note.item: Counter Pro 0.7.0: No changes to this element. The version follows the shared Elemen 0.7.0 release, whose common plugin code gained support for YOOtheme event listeners. From here on this element has its own version.

Flip Box Pro 0.7.0: No changes to this element. The version follows the shared Elemen 0.7.0 release, whose common plugin code gained support for YOOtheme event listeners. From here on this element has its own version.

Heading Pro 0.7.0: No changes to this element. The version follows the shared Elemen 0.7.0 release, whose common plugin code gained support for YOOtheme event listeners. From here on this element has its own version.

Progress Bar Pro 0.7.0: No changes to this element. The version follows the shared Elemen 0.7.0 release, whose common plugin code gained support for YOOtheme event listeners. From here on this element has its own version.

Timeline Pro 0.7.0: No changes to this element. The version follows the shared Elemen 0.7.0 release, whose common plugin code gained support for YOOtheme event listeners. From here on this element has its own version.

addition.item: Shape Dividers Pro 0.7.0: First release: a Shape Divider panel for YOOtheme's Section, opened from its Settings tab, with a top and a bottom shape: 17 original shapes (waves, curves, tilts, triangles, arrows, clouds, mountains and more, some layered).

Shape Dividers Pro 0.7.0: Color Auto (the default) takes the background of the neighbouring section: its style, background color or gradient, or the media background color. Default, Muted, Primary, Secondary and Custom colors too.
Shape Dividers Pro 0.7.0: Height (and height on phones), width up to 300%, flip, invert and in front of the content.
Shape Dividers Pro 0.7.0: Custom SVG: an SVG file from the site, cleaned of scripts and outside references, and stretched like the built-in shapes.
Shape Dividers Pro 0.7.0: Sway and Breathe animations (slow, medium, fast), off with reduced motion.
Shape Dividers Pro 0.7.0: Hide below 640px or 960px.
Counter Pro 0.6.0: Count Style Odometer: each digit rolls into place, while separators, decimals and short-form letters stay put.
Flip Box Pro 0.6.0: Back List: one feature per line on the back, shown with an icon and color set on the element.
Heading Pro 0.6.0: Words in {braces} in the text before or after the highlight become extra highlights, with the same style and drawn shape.
Progress Bar Pro 0.6.0: Label position "Value in a bubble": a bubble that travels with the end of the bar. Goal marks sit on the bar below it.
Timeline Pro 0.6.0: Item Group (for example a year): a label on the line where the group changes, optionally sticky while scrolling through the group.
Counter Pro 0.5.0: Number Format Short (1.3K, 3.4M) and Malay (1.3 ribu, 1.3 juta), counted in the same format.
Counter Pro 0.4.0: Multiple counters in one element: content per item, style and grid settings once on the element. Grid columns per screen size, matching heights and a delay between items.
Counter Pro 0.4.0: Each item can set its own number color.
Flip Box Pro 0.5.0: 3D Depth: the content floats above the box while it turns (flip effects only).
Flip Box Pro 0.4.0: Multiple flip boxes in one element: content per item, style and grid settings once on the element. Grid columns per screen size, matching heights and a delay between items.
Flip Box Pro 0.4.0: Each item can set its own front and back background and text color.
Heading Pro 0.5.0: Text Reveal: the heading appears word by word or letter by letter (fade up, fade, blur, slide, zoom) when it scrolls into view. The highlight stays whole.
Progress Bar Pro 0.5.0: Goal and Goal Label per item, drawn as a mark on bars and a radial tick on circles and half circles, with a goal color.
Timeline Pro 0.5.0: Horizontal layout: items side by side with sideways scrolling and snap, the date above the line and previous/next buttons that hide when everything fits.

change.item: Counter Pro 0.5.0: Malay short numbers keep the number and word on one line (no-break space).
Counter Pro 0.5.0: Mirrors correctly in right-to-left languages.
Counter Pro 0.4.0: Layouts made with 0.3 are converted when they load: the counter becomes the first item, so pages look the same.
Flip Box Pro 0.5.0: The item's Content tab is a plain list of fields, with Front and Back in the labels, so editors and image pickers get the full width.
Flip Box Pro 0.5.0: The slide-left effect follows the text direction in right-to-left languages.
Flip Box Pro 0.4.0: Layouts made with 0.3 are converted when they load: the box becomes the first item, so pages look the same.
Heading Pro 0.5.0: Letter mode falls back to words for joined scripts such as Arabic and Jawi, and screen readers get the whole heading through aria-label.
Heading Pro 0.5.0: Mirrors correctly in right-to-left languages.
Timeline Pro 0.5.0: Mirrors correctly in right-to-left languages, including the reveal animation.

note.item: Heading Pro 0.4.0: No changes to this element; version follows the shared Elemen 0.4.0 release.
Progress Bar Pro 0.4.0: No changes to this element; version follows the shared Elemen 0.4.0 release.
Timeline Pro 0.4.0: No changes to this element; version follows the shared Elemen 0.4.0 release.

fix.item: Progress Bar Pro 0.5.0: Labels inside the bar stay readable in dark (inverse) sections.
Progress Bar Pro 0.5.0: Nothing is output, assets included, when every item is empty.
Timeline Pro 0.5.0: Line segments stop at the marker edges, so outline and not-yet-reached markers are hollow on any background.
Timeline Pro 0.5.0: Markers use dark text in dark (inverse) sections.
Timeline Pro 0.5.0: Nothing is output, assets included, when every item is empty.

addition.item: Counter Pro 0.3.0: First release: count-up numbers with prefix and suffix, separators, decimals, gradient, icon layouts and card styles.
Flip Box Pro 0.3.0: First release: a two-sided box with flip, slide, fade and zoom effects on hover, keyboard focus, click or tap.

Heading Pro 0.2.0: First release: a YOOtheme Headline with a highlighted part in a second color, gradient, animated gradient, outline or marker; drawn SVG shapes or rotating words (typewriter, fade, slide, flip, clip, zoom); kicker and background text.
Heading Pro 0.2.0: CSS and JavaScript load only on pages that use the element, and respect reduced motion.
Progress Bar Pro 0.3.0: First release: bars, circles and half circles with counting values, stripes, gradients, per-item colors and grid columns.
Timeline Pro 0.3.0: First release: left, right or alternating timeline, dot, icon or number markers, a line that fills as you scroll and reveal animations.

change.item: Heading Pro 0.3.0: Heading Pro is now its own plugin, plg_system_elemen_heading_pro, installable on its own.
